qAndA.question: What color is the largest ring?
What is one of the games you can play using the Darts Practice Rings?

qAndA.answer: They help prevent boredom while practicing and can improve skills, potentially leading to opportunities to play in tournaments with significant prize money.
qAndA.question: Why does Eric Bristow recommend the Darts Practice Rings for young players?

qAndA.answer: Informative and persuasive, aiming to educate viewers about the product's benefits and encourage them to purchase it.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the video?

qAndA.answer: He asks local dart players to throw darts at the board, first with the larger ring and then with the smaller ring. They easily hit the target with the larger ring but struggle with the smaller one, demonstrating the increased challenge it presents.
qAndA.question: How does Eric Bristow demonstrate the difference in difficulty between the ring sizes?

youtube_description:
This video was shot and produced by Studiowide at Riley's in Stoke. http://www.studiowide.co.uk

The Darts Practice Rings are another great retail product that was designed and developed by Studiowide. We were commissioned to create the next best thing in darts - and we've certainly done that!

We took an idea for a darts training aid and created a product that is in demand and stocked by darts retailers world-wide.

All marketing and creative work, including practice rings design, testing, technical drawings, packaging design, packaging sourcing, brochure design, promotional video production, training video production - motion graphics, product photography and website development was provided in-house. 

Studiowide was also pivotal in the development of the retail channel for the original Darts Practice Rings, which has since led to world-wide brand recognition and huge demand for this product.

More product development and marketing case studies from Studiowide can be viewed here: http://www.studiowide.co.uk
